title: SSR with TAA Flickering
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.6.1.stable
- Reproducible in Godot 4.7.dev1
- Tested in Godot 4.5.2.stable, bug present, presents differently

### System information

Tested and reproducible on 2 systems: EndeavourOS (Arch Linux) Wayland with AMD CPU and Nvidia 3060Ti(590.48.01), Kubuntu(Ubuntu) X11 with Intel CPU and Intel integrated graphics(CML GT2)

### Issue description

Screen space reflections and TAA used together introduces temporal flickering in static scenes.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5a83340-353a-4d64-ab87-0234bf9a4ab9
(No AA, static scene)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ea48ce32-d2ed-44e4-90d2-61c5f0dca32c
(TAA, static scene)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/145a7f4b-21ec-4743-b6dc-786ccd89c9c4
(No AA, dynamic scene)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6746343e-06bd-42e1-a691-6cd0fb46e02d
(TAA, dynamic scene)

### Steps to reproduce

From MRP:
1. Enable TAA in project settings
2. Open cube_interior.tscn
3. Run current scene

From empty project:
1. Add WorldEnvironment with SSR turned on
2. Add MeshInstance with a material with roughness set low and metallic set to 1
3. Add a new MeshInstance with a bright material
4. Add Camera3D
5. Position the two MeshInstance so that the reflective surface is pointed at both a visible and occluded portion of the bright object in the camera
6. Enable TAA in project settings
7. Run scene

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ssr-taa-flickering.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25722759/ssr-taa-flickering.zip)
